verification.rule: a row is official_verified only when a committed official snapshot printed the value; everything else is mirror_only and flagged. Blank means not played, never unknown-but-filled.

join_notes: Team codes: the official pages print AZ, the mirror prints ARI; all other club codes are identical. The join maps only these two spellings (TEAM_CODE_MAP in tools/build_results_feed.py); each source's own spelling is preserved in its own file.
known_limitations: Historical finals (2019-2025 and 2026 Weeks 1-9) have no committed official page in this repository, so they are mirror_only — usable for backtests, labelled not official (flag F-11).
The official standings snapshot predates the Thursday Night game, so recomputed 2026 records for WAS and NYG differ from it by exactly that game (flag F-12).
Full official box scores for every game remain an open owner question (Q-04); this feed does not close it, it makes the gap explicit per row.
roi_usage: Settlement for any bet row is a join on game_id: W/L/P from away_score/home_score and the recorded market line. Only rows with status=final settle; scheduled rows contribute nothing to ROI.
